verdicts.reason: A shoves the whole composition to the left. The skyline ends abruptly at about x=580 and leaves a dead grey band with a visible background seam on the right, so it looks lopsided and unfinished. B keeps the card, quote and attribution centred and in proportion, but it is still a shrunken copy: the skyline stops short of both canvas edges, the grey side margins have hard seams, and the city base no longer runs full-bleed the way it does in the original.
